stem: Drainage appears almost immediately after irrigation, but container mass increases very little and interior media remains dry. What is the most likely management issue to investigate?
choices: Preferential flow or channeling may be allowing water to bypass part of the root zone instead of being retained through the interior media
Low EC may be increasing root respiration enough to force irrigation water through the container before the media can retain it, so nutrient concentration should be raised first
A photoperiod mismatch may be causing the media to repel water during irrigation even though the interior remains dry afterward
Excess dissolved oxygen in the irrigation water may be reducing water retention and causing rapid drainage through otherwise dry media
rationale: Rapid drainage with little retained water and dry interior media is consistent with nonuniform wetting or preferential flow. Distribution should be investigated before increasing total application blindly.
